annotations.title: Best-of list for a Los Angeles place or need

description: The published Journeyed best-of list for a Los Angeles place ("best hotels near SoFi Stadium", "best hotels in Santa Monica") or for a need across Los Angeles (pet friendly, pool, kitchen). Returns the ranked hotels with the points each earned and the sourced reasons why (awards, hotel class, verified facts, distance), plus the published formula. "Best" means first by that formula, built from checkable facts: no guest reviews, no prices, and no hotel can pay to be listed. Give place or need (at least one).

limit.description: How many hotels to return (1 to 10, default 5). The result gives the URL of the full list.

need.description: Optional. A need with a market-wide best-of list: pet friendly, pool, kitchen.

place.description: Optional. A Los Angeles area landmark, venue, airport or neighborhood by name, for example "SoFi Stadium", "LAX", "Disneyland", "Santa Monica". list_places gives every place covered.

name: best_hotels

available.description: When found is false: the best-of lists that exist.

items.description: One hotel of a ranked list, with its journeyed.org page URL.
One sourced fact. sourceUrl (a web page) or dataset (an open dataset id) says where it came from; checkedOn is the date it was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

parts.description: Points by part of the formula: awards, class, facts, votes, distance.

method.description: The published formula behind the ranking.

page.description: The published journeyed.org page the rows come from. Cite url.
